statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across 58 checks and five representative paths. The fresh-load consent wall was evaluated as part of the real experience; content DOM/raw HTML remained inspectable.

page.notes: Greek breaking-news publisher. Raw HTML preserves 93-96% of rendered content. Audited homepage, section, all-news listing, article, consent entry state, and 404 recovery. Not covered: login/subscription/checkout (not exposed), games and the separate English-domain templates (distinct products/templates), and destructive/account flows.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated dark media screenshot plus computed-style/CSS probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, body remained rgb(255,255,255) on rgb(0,0,0), color-scheme computed as normal, and the dark screenshot was byte-identical to light.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated reduced-motion getAnimations() and stylesheet probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, eight animations remained, including three 30s infinite animations and one 6s infinite animation; CSS contained no prefers-reduced-motion rule.

checkOutcomes.method: Stylesheet feature probe and Lighthouse contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Stylesheet probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling, while Lighthouse found 3.68:1 low-contrast text.

checkOutcomes.method: Fetched same-origin stylesheet/script inspection across the homepage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Same-document news navigation and content state are present, but fetched CSS/JS contained no view-transition usage.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual recon and fetched CSS inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, or entry/exit reveal that needed scroll-linked animation was observed on representative news templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative pages did not expose a scroll-linked animation to implement.

checkOutcomes.method: Fetched CSS probe and mobile layout inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS probe found scroll-snap support and no evidence that core article/list scrolling was replaced by a custom pointer-driven surface.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/script and same-origin CSS inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The header is wired to a JavaScript stickit plugin, while fetched CSS contained no scroll-state container query or declarative scroll progress treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM ancestor/computed-position probe and fetched CSS inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site exposes menus and a consent overlay, but CSS contains no anchor-name or position-anchor support; the overlay is a manually layered fixed div.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM/navigation and crawler-visible screenshot review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Persistent labelled section navigation, article cards, headings, and a distinct current content hierarchy provide clear destinations and attention cues.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop/mobile load screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Every fresh load is fully obscured by a long consent dialog describing 1,726 partners; desktop and 360px screenshots show no news content until a choice is made.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM primitive count and dialog ancestor inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The consent modal uses role=dialog on nested divs rather than <dialog>, and the page contains zero dialog, popover, or details primitives.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM interaction count, mobile layout metrics, and screenshot review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage has 475 visible interactive elements and a 41,385px mobile document, while a full-viewport consent layer dominates the initial experience.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile layout primitive on homepage and article.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360x800 the homepage and article both reported scrollWidth=clientWidth=360, zero horizontal overflow, and a valid viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: Same-origin stylesheet feature probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Fetched first-party stylesheets contain no @container rules despite cards/components being reused across the 41,385px responsive homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Computed focus style and target-size probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Keyboard focus was visible, but 90 of 475 visible interactive elements measured below 24px in at least one dimension.

checkOutcomes.method: Homepage title, nav, headings, and links inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The title, section navigation, all-news link, and descriptive story links clearly identify a breaking-news publication and expose the next reading action.

checkOutcomes.method: Homepage, section, listing, and article fresh-load screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The primary reading journey is needlessly interrupted before any content can be read by the full-viewport consent dialog on every tested route.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP status probe and rendered 404 DOM inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A fabricated route returned a real HTTP 404 after redirect, used a descriptive 404 title, and retained navigation links back into the site.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus raw-CDP performance trace summary.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse performance was 0.57 with LCP 15.5s, Speed Index 9.3s, TBT 290ms, and TTI 18.4s; the independent trace measured LCP 4.99s.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse and mobile layout-shift observer.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CLS was 0.052 in Lighthouse and 0.041 on the 360px layout run, both within the good threshold.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse and trace long-task/TBT analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured 290ms TBT and 18.4s time to interactive; the trace also captured a 72ms long task.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live DOM stylesheet/script attributes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load transferred 3.34MB in 126 requests; 54 scripts transferred 1.68MB, and parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets were present.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code-coverage diagnostics and HAR origin weights.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 603KiB unused JavaScript and 49KiB unused CSS; repeated Google tag bundles dominate the waste list.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits and DOM semantics probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found unnamed social links, unnamed mainLink overlays, and nine images lacking alt; the independent probe counted 174 unnamed visible interactive elements.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse color-contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found repeated 3.68:1 text contrast failures for Games, tabs, and timestamps against white.

checkOutcomes.method: Focus computed-style probe, heading DOM inspection, and Lighthouse heading-order audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus styling was visible, but the homepage H1 is empty and Lighthouse found skipped heading levels including H3/H4 starts.

checkOutcomes.method: Article metadata/text inspection and mobile layout/reflow evidence.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Article titles and body copy use readable Greek text, descriptive line wrapping, and no horizontal clipping at 360px.

checkOutcomes.method: Viewport, target-size, media, and mobile layout probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport permits scaling and reflows without horizontal overflow, but 90 visible targets are below 24px and the detected video has no captions track.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse logged no browser console errors.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM document probe and images primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The doctype and charset are valid, but 95 of 100 inspected images lack explicit dimensions and 93 lack srcset; six lacked alt.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices and DOM/runtime inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No console errors or permission prompts on load were observed; Lighthouse best-practices completed without a deprecated-API or paste-prevention finding in the inspected evidence.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probes and discoverability primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage and article expose unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions in rendered and raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO plus mobile layout and robots inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse passed crawlable anchors, robots.txt validity, crawlability, and viewport; the mobile layout has no overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Metadata probes, discoverability HTTP results, and robots/sitemap fetch.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage and article return 200, declare self-canonicals, are index/follow, and robots/sitemap endpoints are available.

checkOutcomes.method: Article JSON-LD/Open Graph probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The article contains NewsArticle JSON-LD and matching Open Graph title, description, URL, author, image, and update time.

checkOutcomes.method: Headers and cookies primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP and X-Content-Type-Options are absent; four analytics cookies are not Secure and all eight observed cookies were flagged insecure by the cookie audit.

checkOutcomes.method: Trackers primitive, HAR summary, and fresh-load consent screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load contacted 22 third-party origins and seven known tracker domains; 74 third-party requests transferred 2.37MB before a consent choice.

checkOutcomes.method: Fresh-load runtime/visual inspection and representative-flow applicability review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No notification/geolocation permission prompt fired on load; authentication is not part of the representative public-news journey.

checkOutcomes.method: Security headers primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff are all absent; only HSTS is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Discoverability raw-versus-rendered comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML preserved 96% of homepage and 93% of article rendered content; both titles/descriptions survive without JavaScript and the article H1 does too.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile layout and rendered control inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The responsive pages retained navigation and content structure at 360px with no overflow; the consent overlay fit the viewport and exposed explicit choices.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest and service-worker capability probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A valid standalone manifest exists, but this live breaking-news publication is intrinsically network-current; an offline app experience was not treated as required.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline content freshness/installability is contextual for this network-current news publication.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP and rendered 404 inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: An unknown route resolves to an HTTP 404 page with a descriptive title and retained navigation rather than a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language/navigation and fetched stylesheet probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Greek site declares html lang=el, uses logical CSS properties, and provides a visible English-site switch; Greek is left-to-right so an explicit dir is not required.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM/time element and language navigation inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered dates use Greek relative-time strings and machine-readable ISO datetime values; a dedicated English edition is linked.

checkOutcomes.method: Article Open Graph and DOM datetime inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Article metadata and visible time elements carry unambiguous ISO offsets such as +03:00 and updated_time values.

checkOutcomes.method: Fresh-load screenshot plus trackers, cookies, and HAR evidence.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first screen is a dense consent wall naming 1,726 partners; tracking requests and analytics cookies are already present before the user chooses, undermining an informed, honest default.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse label audit and 404 inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The public content flow has no required form; Lighthouse found form controls labelled and the 404 state uses a clear title with recovery navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative route and form-purpose inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No address, payment, sign-in, or sign-up data-entry flow is present in the representative public-news paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: Only site search/utility inputs were present; the personal-data autofill scenarios in this check do not apply.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative route and navigation inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription purchase, authentication, or account-management flow was exposed on the representative public-news paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No commercial or account flow was present in the audited scope.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive and HAR resource totals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Of 100 inspected images, 93 lack srcset, 95 lack dimensions, 17 use legacy formats, and seven are oversized; images transferred 1.11MB.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and Lighthouse unused-code diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial load makes 126 requests and ships 1.68MB of scripts; Lighthouse estimates 603KiB unused JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party byte accounting and trackers primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 74 requests and 2.37MB, including 1.12MB from Google Tag Manager alone, disproportionate for the initial text-news view.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw/rendered discoverability and source feature probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site publishes crawler-readable HTML and JSON-LD but declares no agent-facing transactional capability; WebMCP was not treated as required for this public news surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing action surface or declared WebMCP intent was identified; this emerging check is contextual.

checkOutcomes.method: Fetched script feature probe and task applicability review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No user task in the representative paths requires on-device inference, and no built-in language-model API use was found.
checkOutcomes.reason: Built-in on-device inference is an optional emerging enhancement, not required for basic news reading.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline and post-interaction heap summaries using repeated real scrolling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten full-document scroll cycles, the post heap was smaller than baseline: 959,239 vs 997,826 nodes and 52.18MB vs 53.60MB self size.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary totals judged against page purpose and HAR/script weight.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A fresh homepage heap contains 997,826 nodes and 53.60MB self size, a large footprint for a document whose core task is reading news.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor and total comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appeared among the top heap constructors, and node count fell by 38,587 after repeated scrolling rather than growing.

principleOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing action surface or declared WebMCP intent was identified; this emerging check is contextual. Built-in on-device inference is an optional emerging enhancement, not required for basic news reading.

paths.description: Homepage and consent entry state: primary news discovery, global navigation, preferences, performance, privacy, accessibility, and memory.
Greece section listing: representative category/index template and narrow-screen entry state.
All News listing: high-density chronological listing and navigation archetype.
News article: representative content/detail template, metadata, reading flow, narrow layout, and no-JS discoverability.
Unknown URL: HTTP and navigation recovery state.

findings.guidanceId: dark-mode
findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark-color preference.
findings.evidence: Dark emulation stayed white with color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surfaces/text through light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme layer.

findings.guidanceId: accessibility
findings.summary: Long-running motion continues under reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: Eight animations remained, including infinite 30s and 6s animations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce layer that removes non-essential animation and auto-advance.

findings.guidanceId: adapt-scrollbar-to-contrast-preferences
findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are unsupported.
findings.evidence: No forced-colors/prefers-contrast CSS; ordinary mode already has 3.68:1 text.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast styles, preserving system colors and visible boundaries.

findings.guidanceId: cross-document-transitions
findings.summary: Content navigation does not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: No view-transition usage was found in first-party CSS/JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin article and section navigation with cross-document View Transitions.

findings.guidanceId: shrinking-header-on-scroll
findings.summary: Sticky navigation is driven by a JavaScript plugin rather than scroll-state-aware CSS.
findings.evidence: DOM uses data-plugin-stickit; no scroll-state query was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace eligible sticky-header state toggling with scroll-state container queries and a fallback.

findings.guidanceId: position-aware-tooltips
findings.summary: Menus/overlays do not use anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: No anchor-name/position-anchor CSS was found; consent is a fixed high-z div.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning/position-try for anchored menus where applicable.

findings.guidanceId: light-dismiss-a-dialog
findings.summary: A full-screen consent wall blocks every primary content path.
findings.evidence: Fresh desktop/mobile/article screens show only the long consent copy and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a concise, non-blocking consent surface with equal choices; defer non-essential partners until consent.

findings.guidanceId: Overlay UI is built from nested divs rather than native top-layer primitives.
findings.summary: role=dialog exists, but there are zero <dialog>, popover, or details elements.
findings.evidence: Use <dialog> for the modal flow and popover/details for transient/disclosure UI with platform dismissal.

findings.guidanceId: The homepage is exceptionally dense before users reach a story.
findings.summary: 475 visible controls and a 41,385px mobile document accompany the blocking consent layer.
findings.evidence: Reduce duplicated modules/chrome and prioritise a smaller set of top stories and clear section paths.

findings.guidanceId: Reusable cards rely on page-level responsiveness only.
findings.summary: No @container rule was found in first-party styles.
findings.evidence: Give reusable card/list modules containment and adapt their internals with container queries.

findings.guidanceId: Many interactive targets are too small.
findings.summary: 90 visible controls measured below 24px in width or height.
findings.evidence: Increase hit areas toward WCAG 2.2 target-size guidance while retaining visible focus.

findings.guidanceId: Largest Contentful Paint is extremely slow.
findings.summary: Lighthouse LCP was 15.5s, performance 57, Speed Index 9.3s, and TTI 18.4s.
findings.evidence: Prioritise the LCP image/content, cut early third-party work, and defer non-critical scripts/styles.

findings.guidanceId: The page becomes interactive slowly.
findings.summary: Lighthouse TBT was 290ms and TTI 18.4s; trace found a 72ms long task.
findings.evidence: Break up long tasks and schedule/defer analytics, players, and below-fold modules by priority.

findings.guidanceId: The initial dependency graph is heavy.
findings.summary: 126 requests/3.34MB, including 54 scripts/1.68MB and parser-blocking styles.
findings.evidence: Shorten critical chains, remove duplicate tags, defer third parties, and optimise LCP discovery.

findings.guidanceId: Large unused JS/CSS payloads ship on first load.
findings.summary: Lighthouse estimates 603KiB unused JS and 49KiB unused CSS.
findings.evidence: Conditionally load players, CMP modules, and analytics destinations; split the site stylesheet by template.

findings.guidanceId: Many links and images lack accessible names.
findings.summary: Lighthouse found unnamed social/mainLink anchors and missing-alt images; probe counted 174 unnamed controls.
findings.evidence: Give icon/overlay links accessible names and meaningful images alt text, hiding decorative images correctly.

findings.guidanceId: Secondary text fails WCAG contrast.
findings.summary: Lighthouse measured 3.68:1 for navigation, tabs, and timestamps.
findings.evidence: Darken the muted text token to achieve at least 4.5:1 for normal text.

findings.guidanceId: The homepage heading hierarchy is broken.
findings.summary: The H1 is empty and Lighthouse found H3/H4 level skips.
findings.evidence: Add one meaningful H1 and make section/card headings descend sequentially.

findings.guidanceId: Small targets and uncaptionsed video reduce comparable access.
findings.summary: 90 targets are under 24px and the detected video has no captions track.
findings.evidence: Enlarge hit areas and provide captions/transcripts for editorial video.

findings.guidanceId: Image markup lacks intrinsic and responsive sizing.
findings.summary: 95/100 images lack dimensions and 93/100 lack srcset.
findings.evidence: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio and responsive srcset/sizes for every editorial image.

findings.guidanceId: Security headers and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.summary: No CSP or nosniff; four analytics cookies are not Secure.
findings.evidence: Deploy a measured CSP, nosniff, and Secure/Lax cookie defaults, then tighten via report-only telemetry.

findings.guidanceId: Tracking starts with a very large third-party footprint.
findings.summary: 22 third-party origins, seven known trackers, and 2.37MB third-party bytes were observed before choice.
findings.evidence: Block non-essential tags until consent and consolidate to a minimal, privacy-preserving measurement plan.

findings.guidanceId: Most browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.summary: No CSP/frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or nosniff.
findings.evidence: Add CSP frame-ancestors, nosniff, strict referrer policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.guidanceId: Consent defaults are not trustworthy.
findings.summary: The wall names 1,726 partners while trackers/cookies activate before a user choice.
findings.evidence: Adopt privacy-by-default: no optional tags before consent, concise purposes, and equivalent accept/reject controls.

findings.guidanceId: Editorial images are not consistently responsive or modern.
findings.summary: 93 images lack srcset, 17 are legacy format, and seven are oversized.
findings.evidence: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and accurate srcset/sizes with intrinsic dimensions.

findings.guidanceId: The initial page performs substantial avoidable work.
findings.summary: 126 requests, 1.68MB scripts, and 603KiB estimated unused JS.
findings.evidence: Load modules only near use, remove duplicate analytics, and pause/deprioritise background work.

findings.guidanceId: Third-party cost dominates the first view.
findings.summary: Third parties transfer 2.37MB; Google Tag Manager origins alone transfer 1.12MB.
findings.evidence: Set a third-party byte/request budget and enforce delayed, consent-gated loading.

findings.guidanceId: The fresh homepage has a large memory footprint.
findings.summary: Heap summary reports 997,826 nodes and 53.60MB self size.
findings.evidence: Reduce duplicated DOM/modules and only instantiate below-fold widgets when near the viewport.

taskList.title: Make privacy consent genuinely opt-in and gate all optional tags
Cut LCP and first-load JavaScript/third-party cost
Repair accessible names, heading structure, contrast, targets, and captions
Harden response headers and cookie flags
Build a responsive image pipeline with dimensions and modern formats
Add dark, reduced-motion, and high-contrast preference layers
Reduce homepage DOM/chrome and instantiate below-fold modules lazily
Modernise overlays, sticky state, navigation transitions, and component responsiveness
